Subject: Security exhibit details + pen test expectations

Marcus — thanks for sending the draft exhibit earlier. A few items procurement/legal flagged after an internal review: 

1) Audit window: our legal team wants clarity on timing and maximum duration for on-site / remote audits — can you confirm Redwood's expected notice window and the typical cadence for evidence delivery?
2) Pen test language: we need confirmation that Redwood will allow a third-party pen test with a scoped, mutual testing window and non-disruptive rules of engagement. We usually require 30 days' notice and a testing plan.
3) SOC 2 evidence: we requested a timeline for artifact delivery (SOC 2 Type II report, encryption details, user access logs) and who the point of contact will be for those requests.

Attached: high-level vendor questionnaire (procurement). Can we align this week on what Redwood can commit to in the MSA/security exhibit so legal can proceed with redlines?

Olivia
Senior Procurement Manager
Atlas Health

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>

Date: 2026-11-26T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit details + pen test expectations

Thanks Olivia — looping in Laura (legal) and Karthik (security/compliance) so we can get concrete language to you. Quick answers up front:

- Notice window: Redwood's standard is 30 days' notice for a scheduled assessment; for emergency audits we have a 72-hour SLA to triage requests and propose a plan.
- Pen test: we do permit third-party pentests under a mutually agreed scope and rules of engagement; we require a test plan and proof of insurance from the tester. We prefer a 30-day notice window and a 48-hour blackout for production-impacting tests.
- Evidence cadence: SOC 2 report and supporting artifacts can be provided via a secure share. For recurring evidence requests, we propose a quarterly evidence bundle for control areas plus an ad-hoc window for specific items (logs, configurations) within 5 business days.

Action: Karthik — can you review and propose explicit exhibit language for the MSA (audit rights, pen test clause, evidence delivery SLAs)? Laura — can you advise if the above is acceptable from a legal posture or if we should offer alternate wording?

Thanks,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-28T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit details + pen test expectations

Folks — draft language below that I believe balances Atlas' asks with our operational constraints. Please review and call out any hard no's. I'll attach a simple pen-test matrix that maps request -> typical SLA/response.

Proposed exhibit snippets (to add to MSA security exhibit):
- Audit Notice & Scope: "Customer may request an audit of Redwood's compliance artifacts with 30 days' prior written notice. Redwood will provide a proposed schedule and scope within 5 business days and reasonable cooperation. Audits shall be conducted during Redwood's normal business hours unless otherwise agreed."
- Penetration Testing: "Customer may engage a mutually agreed third-party security assessor to conduct non-disruptive penetration testing on Redwood-managed production systems. The Customer must provide a detailed test plan and evidence of tester insurance at least 30 days prior. Redwood reserves the right to reject specific test activities that could materially impact service availability. Redwood will propose alternative test methods or windows when necessary."
- Evidence Delivery SLA: "For standard compliance artifacts (SOC 2 Type II report, encryption config, control matrices), Redwood will deliver via secure share within 10 business days of a formal request. For targeted log or configuration exports, Redwood will make commercially reasonable efforts to deliver within 5 business days; critical incident evidence will follow incident response timelines."

Pen-test matrix (high level): request type -> earliest availability -> notes:
- Full external pentest -> 30 days -> limited production scope; 48-hour pre-test blackout for high-impact checks
- Scoped app-layer assessment -> 21 days -> possible to run during off-peak hours
- Vulnerability scanning (non-invasive) -> 10 days -> automated scans with prior notice

I'll attach pen-test-matrix.xlsx with typical lead times and required artifacts. Laura, any required legal tweaks (e.g., indemnity or confidentiality wrap) we should pre-include?

-Karthik
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachment: pen-test-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@atlashealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-30T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security exhibit details + pen test expectations

Olivia / Atlas team — appreciate the clear asks and the questionnaire. We've reviewed Karthik's proposed wording and can accept with the following clarifications to be included in the exhibit or order form: 

1) Non-disclosure & findings handling: All pen-test findings will be delivered to the Customer and Redwood; Customer agrees that findings are confidential and will not be redistributed beyond its security team without Redwood's consent for 90 days while remediation is underway.
2) Liability cap: All pen-test activities must respect the liability caps in the MSA; Redwood will not accept open-ended indemnity for third-party testers.
3) Evidence channel: SOC 2 and control artifacts will be shared via a pre-authorized secure link (Redwood S3 share with time-limited access). For recurring evidence requests, let's document a quarterly cadence and an ad-hoc 5-business-day SLA for targeted artifacts.

Next steps I propose: 
- Marcus: send Atlas the revised exhibit PDF (I will review redlines inline) and the pen-test matrix.
- Olivia / Tina: confirm if Atlas can accept the 90-day handling period for findings and the evidence SLAs.
- If agreed, procurement/legal can sign off and we can add exhibit as an addendum to the Order Form.

Thanks — happy to jump on a short call if you want to walk through the language.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1-650-555-0199
